description: SiliconFlow's OpenAI-compatible Chat API plus native embeddings, rerank, image, audio, and asynchronous video APIs.
residency_notes: SiliconFlow's public policy allows personal data to be processed by affiliates and service providers inside or outside Singapore and does not specify a customer-selected inference or storage region. Its policy does not provide a named API Zero Data Retention control for interaction data.
prompt_training_notes: SiliconFlow describes interaction data as the customer's business data and says it will only process interaction data strictly in accordance with customer instructions as a neutral technology service provider.

sources.notes: Documents the global Chat Completions host, Bearer authentication, request controls, SSE streaming, reasoning output, usage, and error responses.
Complete first-party API index used to verify adjacent embeddings, rerank, image, audio, video, and Anthropic Messages surfaces and the absence of Responses and Batch references.

verification.notes: Global Chat route, auth, streaming, tools, structured output, reasoning controls/output, usage, errors, and adjacent modalities verified against first-party references.
